indexes.name: events_context_reading_idx
indexes.sql: SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_context_reading_idx WHERE (json_extract(event_json, '$.event.type') = 'compaction_completed' OR COALESCE(json_type(event_json, '$.event.usage'), 'null') != 'null') = 1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='type' AND sequence<100 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 32
plan: SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX events_context_reading_idx (<expr>=? AND <expr>=? AND sequence<?)
